verdict.rationale: ROS 2 provides official client libraries (Python/C++) with topics, services, and actions for commanding robots, including goals, feedback, and cancel. SROS2/DDS-Security adds participant authentication, and security enclaves apply per-policy scoping, so scoped credentials plus SDK control are documented primitives. However, nothing in the evidence addresses AI-agent use, and end-to-end real-robot command depends on hardware drivers that aren't documented here. missing for 10: any AI-agent-specific integration or guidance, documented end-to-end real-robot command flow under enclave-scoped credentials, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven control.
